title: The Wizard Who Lay With 10,000 Girls
description:
Walpurgis is a magic academy ruled by beautiful spirit girls with overwhelming magical power and sexual desire: “There’s no way human men could ever satisfy us♡”

A single wizard transfers into this academy of arrogant, beautiful spirit girls who look down on humans. His only weapon is... An absurdly potent sexual prowess that even the spirits find terrifying!!

With that overwhelming prowess, he proceeds to make one proud, beautiful spirit girl after another submit to him...?!

A conquest harem erotic-comedy fantasy begins at a magic academy where the traditional roles of chastity have been reversed, as this wizard takes on a bunch of arrogant, bratty beauties and makes them learn their place!!
author: Amaui Shiro
